reason: EMPHASIS-HF: NYHA II, EF <=35%, registry minimum age 55. Served HR 0.76 (0.62-0.93) is printed in the abstract and equals the registry's cut-off analysis HR 0.761 (0.622-0.932), 171 vs 213. The complete-DB counts (205 vs 253) carry no HR, so the extractor's 'longer follow-up' objection has no alternative number and is rejected. The INELIGIBLE screen verdict traces to the registry listing ONE arm group typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR while its outcome groups name a placebo arm: a registry label, not a trial fact.

extractor_mismatch_note: The served HR 0.76 (95% CI 0.62 to 0.93) matches the abstract's all-cause mortality result at premature stopping after median follow-up of 21 months. It does not establish the requested longest randomized follow-up: the registry reports later complete double-blind results through 59.5 months.
